title: Ending a tenancy in the Northern Territory
description: Steps for ending an NT tenancy and returning the security deposit. Summarised from NT Consumer Affairs guidance.

sources.title: A Guide to Renting in the Northern Territory

items.title: Give 60 days' written notice to end a periodic tenancy or not renew a fixed term, using the NT RT05 notice by landlord of intention to terminate
For rent 14 days behind, give the NT RT03 notice to remedy unpaid rent (at least 8 days to pay)
For other breaches, give the NT RT04b notice to remedy breach by tenant and apply to NTCAT within 14 days if needed
Expect the tenant to give you 14 days' notice if they leave
Inspect against the ingoing condition report
Return the security deposit within 7 business days of the tenant leaving
To keep any of it, give the NT RT08 notice of intention to retain security deposit within those 7 business days
Store goods left behind and give the NT RT11 notice of storage of goods
